scalar.regulator: Spherical bath total N<=L times local basis; true SO(3) spin 0 and inversion even for primaries
scalar.scope: Finite-cutoff Hamiltonian plus the opt-in full-vacuum window shift D(N); no other matching.
scalar.solver: factorized operator; fixed density span; full-density Hellmann-Feynman/window Jacobian
scalar.local_auxiliary_residual_scope: eigensolve inside the fixed local span; not its truncation error
scalar.local_retained_edge_weights_scope: top two eigenstates inside the retained span; not discarded density weight

diagnostics.scope: Free-generator ancestry in M=0 representatives. Not interacting conformal charges. Same L in all sectors.
